images.title: Lumière Dress
images.subtitle: Hestia Collection · NOUSHELLA
images.designerCredit: The Lumière Dress was designed by Jalal Mashhadi Fard for NOUSHELLA.
images.description:
The Lumière Dress is a reflection of the intricate latticework found in Persian architecture—those mesmerizing geometric patterns often seen in historic mosques, rich with mystery and symbolism. There is a certain radiance to them, an almost spiritual glow that became the essence of this design.

Created for NOUSHELLA, this piece is part of the Hestia Collection: a tribute to women with deep intuition and quiet strength. The patterns, layered with meaning, give the dress a sense of heritage and depth while celebrating the grace and presence of the woman who wears it.
images.descriptionFa: پیراهن لومیر با الهام از گره‌چینی معماری ایرانی طراحی شده است؛ ساختاری که معمولاً در کاشی‌کاری مساجد تاریخی دیده می‌شود و گویی راز و درخشش معنوی را در دل خود دارد. در نتیجه تلاش شده است تا این درخشش در تار و پود طرح تنیده شود. الهام از این گره و اشاره به این مفهوم در طراحی لباس، ستایشی از نیروی شهودی و وقار درونی زنانه است.

images.title: Anima Collection
images.subtitle: Fashion, accessories and jewelry · NOUSHELLA
images.designerCredit: The Anima Collection was designed by Jalal Mashhadi Fard for NOUSHELLA.
images.description: Anima is conceived as a living design family in which garment, footwear, accessories and jewelry are shaped through one continuous language. Curved layers gather around the body like an embrace, while sculptural details translate inner character into form. The collection brings together the Anima dress, bag, Anya Heels and Persephone jewelry as related expressions of protection, movement and identity.
images.descriptionFa: کالکشن آنیما یک خانوادهٔ طراحی یکپارچه است که در آن لباس، کفش، اکسسوری و جواهرات با یک زبان مشترک شکل گرفته‌اند. لایه‌های منحنی همچون آغوشی بدن را در بر می‌گیرند و جزئیات مجسمه‌وار، شخصیت درونی را به فرم تبدیل می‌کنند. پیراهن آنیما، کیف، کفش Anya و جواهرات Persephone در این مجموعه روایت‌هایی مرتبط از محافظت، حرکت و هویت‌اند.

images.title: Embodied Archetypes
images.subtitle: A study in wearable identity · NOUSHELLA
images.designerCredit: The garments and accompanying visual works were shaped and illustrated by Jalal Mashhadi Fard for NOUSHELLA.
images.description:
Embodied Archetypes reflects on how clothing can hold psychological shape. Each piece begins not with a trend, but with a structure drawn from memory, emotion and symbolic form. Grounded in Carl Jung’s thought, the exhibition traces how identity may find presence through what is worn—between surface and soul, where form becomes a quiet echo of the self.

The project brings seven female archetypes into dialogue through garments and mixed-media works, developed as an ongoing inquiry into feminine form, intuition and identity. Presented at Intent Gallery in Downtown Dubai from 5 September through November 2025.

images.title: Anya Heels
images.subtitle: Footwear Design · NOUSHELLA
images.designerCredit: Anya Heels was designed by Jalal Mashhadi Fard for NOUSHELLA.
images.description: Anya Heels is conceived as an embrace around the foot. The upper folds across and gathers the foot in a soft, protective gesture, translating the intimacy of a hug into a precise sculptural silhouette. The faceted heel extends the concept through an architectural geometry inspired by the vertical rhythm of columns in sacred spaces.
images.descriptionFa: کفش Anya همچون آغوشی پیرامون پا شکل گرفته است. رویه با حرکتی نرم و محافظ، پا را در بر می‌گیرد و صمیمیت یک بغل را به فرمی دقیق و مجسمه‌وار تبدیل می‌کند. هندسهٔ تراش‌خوردهٔ پاشنه نیز با الهام از ریتم عمودی ستون‌ها در فضاهای مذهبی شکل گرفته است.

images.title: Jewelry
images.designerCredit: All jewelry collections presented here were designed by Jalal Mashhadi Fard for NOUSHELLA.
images.description: Seven jewelry collections developed as complete design families for NOUSHELLA. Each collection brings together a ring and a pair of earrings through a shared geometry, material language and mythological identity.
